crop.notes: Clipping is the whole 'Missouri Items' column of unrelated state news; only the 'A Prize Fight' paragraph (crop-3) is about Allen. Right edge clips the last letter of some lines, but the Allen paragraph is readable; the last item is cut off at the bottom.

ocr.notes: Allen paragraph readable but amounts garbled ('$25v0 to 10,04', '200' for what the image shows as $2000; 'Jom Kelly' for Tom Kelly).

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reprinted a Kansas City Times dispatch that Ned O'Baldwin had challenged Jem Mace, who accepted for $2,500 to $10,000, and that Tom Allen would train Mace near St. Louis and back him for $2,000.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'Daily Democrat', Monday Morning, July 3, 1871. Reprint from the Kansas City Times of July 1, quoting a St. Louis dispatch of June 30. Current summary gives $200; the image reads $2000 (some digits faint).

facts.fact: Ned O'Baldwin challenged Jem Mace in St. Louis and Mace accepted for any amount from $2,500 to $10,000
Tom Allen was to train Jem Mace at the Wash Home, four miles from St. Louis, and back him for $2,000 against Ned O'Baldwin
places: Wash Home, four miles from St. Louis

notes: Mace preferred to fight near New Orleans; Tom Kelly was mentioned as O'Baldwin's trainer. Backing amount read as $2000 from a faint image; worth a second look.
